title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: gamma_max=0.74, lam=0.9 (conservative per-PC adaptive residualization)
abstract: Conservative variant: gamma_max=0.74 (our global sweet spot) and lam=0.9 to reduce over-residualization risk; embedding = ComBat+PCA64; graph = adaptive residualized PCs (PC50) + balanced kNN (k=48, cosine).
